description: Change the title, times or description of a calendar event you created. Only events you own can be changed; course events return a permission error. Fields you omit stay the same. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

event_id.description: Calendar event ID (numeric string). Get it from list_calendar_events or list_my_reservations.

title.description: New title. Omit to keep the current one.
